summary.intent: Determine whether phase 71 (share-invite security & IPNS data integrity API) has unresolved design decisions requiring discussion, then proceed to plan it via the GSD workflow.
summary.outcome: Discovered the discussion had already happened on an undiverged local branch (feat/phase-71-share-invite-security) with all open decisions resolved in 71-DISCUSSION-LOG.md; rebased that branch onto latest main, skipped ROADMAP editing per user instruction, and kicked off /gsd-plan-phase 71, which opted into research (due to Nyquist validation Dimension 8 requiring a Validation Architecture section) and successfully produced 71-RESEARCH.md.

repo: Phase discussions in this GSD workflow can live on their own feature branch as a single commit containing CONTEXT.md + DISCUSSION-LOG.md, separate from main, and must be checked for before assuming a discussion is needed

When nyquist_validation_enabled is true, the gsd-plan-checker enforces Dimension 8 which requires a '## Validation Architecture' section that only RESEARCH.md provides — skipping research risks plan-checker failures
CONTEXT.md for phase 71 already had exhaustive locked decisions (D-01…D-09) with file:line refs, SQL, and error codes going into planning
workflow: Before assuming a phase needs a discuss-phase step, check for an existing feature branch with a discussion commit ahead of main (git branch/log search) rather than re-deriving open questions from todos
GSD spawn announcements must include the literal phrase 'runs in a subagent' per ui-brand.md so users don't mistake a live subagent run for a frozen session

friction: User had to interrupt and redirect twice: once to point out a discussion likely already existed on a branch (assistant had started re-deriving open questions from scratch), and once to stop the assistant from manually trimming ROADMAP.md SC#3 and instead let GSD tooling handle it
open_items: ROADMAP.md SC#3 still lists the root-uniqueness partial unique index as part of phase 71 scope even though the discussion log dropped that requirement (decision: vaults.owner_id uniqueness already enforces one-root-per-user) — deferred to GSD tooling rather than manual edit
Phase 71 planning (gsd-plan-phase) was mid-flight at transcript end: research completed (71-RESEARCH.md written) but planner/plan-checker verification loop had not yet run
